printer_intro: Connect your PeriPage to see its battery and device information.
printer_choose_hint: Select your PeriPage in the browser’s Bluetooth dialog.
printer_wait_hint: Keep the printer switched on and nearby.
printer_idle_hint: Switch on your printer, then connect it here.
printer_connected_hint: Information was received from the printer.
printer_cancelled_hint: Device selection was cancelled. You can try again.
printer_disconnected_hint: The connection was closed. Connect again when you need it.
printer_lost_hint: The printer disconnected. Check its power and distance, then connect again.
printer_unsupported: Bluetooth is unavailable in this browser
printer_unsupported_hint: Open this page in Chrome or Edge on a computer to connect your printer.
printer_insecure_hint: Bluetooth requires HTTPS or localhost. Open the app at a secure address.
printer_timeout: The printer did not respond in time. Check it and connect again.
printer_bad_response: The printer returned an unexpected response. Connect again to retry.
printer_permission: Bluetooth access was denied. Allow this site to connect to your printer and try again.
printer_connection_error: Could not connect. Check that the printer is on and is not connected to another app.
printer_information_hint: Read directly from the printer after connecting.
